Vietnam’s Outstanding Export Products Fair 2026 (HCMC Export 2026) is one of Vietnam’s key trade promotion events, aimed at boosting export activities and connecting Vietnamese businesses with a global network of international buyers.

The event is held under the direction of the Ministry of Industry and Trade, the Ho Chi Minh City People’s Committee, and organized by the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade. It provides an ideal platform for businesses to showcase their products, expand into international markets, and strengthen partnerships with domestic and overseas partners.

With an expected scale of over 750 booths, more than 400 international buyers, and 15,000+ trade visitors, HCMC Export 2026 will bring together businesses across Vietnam’s leading export industries, including:

KEY EXHIBIT CATEGORIES

- Food, Agricultural Products & Beverages: OCOP products, Halal products, processed foods, and beverages
- Textiles & Garments, Footwear
- Handicrafts & Gifts
- Household Appliances, Hardware & Hand Tools
- Export Support Services: Logistics, Banking, Insurance, and E-commerce

EVENT INFORMATION

- Date: 22 – 24 October 2026
- Venue: WTC EXPO – World Trade Center Binh Duong New City
- Address: A19 Hung Vuong Street, Binh Duong Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

The event will be held at WTC EXPO – World Trade Center Binh Duong New City, a premier venue for exhibitions, conferences, and large-scale events in Southern Vietnam, offering convenient access to Ho Chi Minh City and the country’s key industrial provinces.
